s00499.summary: Barnaby, Diantha and Gwen hurry backstage as he fusses over a painted mantle.
Barnaby shrugs off Diantha's forgotten line while Gwen reviews cues.
The bell tolls and all three bolt through the curtain.

s02317.summary: Wendy briefs the reluctant family in the van on behavior at Grandma's.
Wendy extracts a no-politics, no-casserole-complaints pledge from Robert.
Grandma waves from the porch; the family bares smiles in unison.
The family files out into the rain, and Maya whispers love you guys.

s00597.summary: Wary guests sit before an untouched feast as the queen summons the seer.
Imbolc prophesies the king will not wake tonight, tension spiking around the table.
The seer names the one who pours; every head turns to pale Lark.

s02105.summary: Musicians and crew idle through rehearsal on the empty stage.
The chandelier chain slips, and everyone scrambles for the wings as it hangs by a thread.
In the stunned silence, Adelheid begins to laugh.

s02239.summary: Sorrel creeps along a ledge in the mirror vault, where reflections move late.
As Sorrel reaches for the crown, Brigid, her older self, steps from a mirror.
They circle, lunge, and fight over a fallen knife until both freeze.
Brigid explains the vault shows what you will become and warns Sorrel to leave.
Sorrel leaves the crown; Brigid thanks her and vanishes into a mirror.

s00306.summary: Otis feeds balls to Leo, drilling her footwork at dawn.
Leo and Coach Otis agree to meet at the same time tomorrow.

s01549.summary: Detective Pip visits her former professor Imogen for tea in the reading room.
Pip catches Imogen knowing about the folio, which the newspaper never mentioned.
Pip notices a gap on the shelf and probes Imogen about borrowed books.
Pip cites Fenwick's letter about a colleague selling folio pages.
Pip produces the torn page found in his hand and Imogen softens.

s00353.summary: A funeral parlor speakeasy hums with bootleggers, bartender and a jazz trio.
Funeral director Whitcomb arrives and demands his casket stands back.
Lenny wakes, Odette stops singing, and the pianist hits a wrong note.

s00547.summary: Inspector Strom walks the sleeper corridor and asks Madame Roux about a disturbance.
Dr. Pryce says she tended a fainting porter; Strom glimpses him on the berth.
Strom notes her ticket was bought in Vienna but she boarded in Prague.
Strom steps in and notes Giles is not breathing; Pryce admits she knows.
Pryce closes the door as Madame Roux's eye watches from the corridor.

s02357.summary: Sheriff Wells, bounty hunter Calista, and prisoner Griggs wait at a dry ferry landing.
Dispatch orders Wells over radio to bring Griggs in alive.
Wells draws his revolver on Griggs, and Calista stops his hand.
Wells decides to wait until dawn; he and Calista sit on the dock.

s00144_0.summary: Three thieves creep through a cheese cave searching for wheel forty.
Angelika finds the hollow wheel, and Didi cracks it to reveal a steel box.
The watchwoman's flashlight arrives; Didi bolts, toppling cheese wheels in an avalanche.

s01798.summary: Coworkers gather awkwardly around a cake for Teodora's retirement.
Teodora reveals thirty-one years of service unnoticed, sitting by the copier.
Everyone scrambles uselessly for a plate until Teodora produces her own.
They sing raggedly, and Shanti thanks Teodora without knowing why.

s02140.summary: Dani laces skates alone in the closed roller rink for a last lap.
Mr. Kallis appears and says her mother called, worried she is always here.
Dani asks whether it matters that she's leaving; Kallis says a rink is where you leave from.
Dani laughs about her father then admits she doesn't want to go.
Kallis plays a slow song and dims the lights as Dani skates.
Dani circles Kallis, says goodbye, and skates out into the night.

s01542.summary: Isabella and Florian inspect a dead barge that still holds pressure.
A voice on the intercom welcomes them, and the floor hatch springs open.
Dolly climbs from the hatch and scolds them as squatters and the barge as creepy.
Reassured, they lower their guard and follow Dolly down for tea.

s02338.summary: A sunglassed man in a tracksuit arrives at the pet cemetery shop wanting to bury a hamster.
Fenella and Toby probe his business decision and haggle over plot and marker.
Pruitt calls to say it's the third hamster this week; Fenella whispers to Toby.
He opens the shoebox, revealing no hamster, and Fenella has Toby lock the door.
Fenella brightly tells Pruitt all is fine while Toby offers the man a candle.
Fenella counts the cash with trembling fingers and locks the box in a drawer.

s01721_1.summary: Stranded passengers share a thermos in a dead cable car; Hollis glances at the roof.
Dara notices Hollis keeps looking up, then the radio crackles.
Rufus warns over radio not to open the hatch and to count the weight.
The car dips, something taps the hatch politely, then taps again beneath the floor.

s00285.summary: Six people crowd a projection booth in the rain around a dead projectionist.
Marguerite declares Paddy dead; panic rises as dragging sounds ascend the stairs.
Mrs. Abernathy says it always wants the projector, and the scraping stops at the door.
Soft knocks, the handle turns, and wet footprints lead to Paddy's body.
Paddy's eyes open and he says roll it; the projectors start and show a giant Holcomb.

s00928.summary: Sparrow drills into the vault grate inside the clock tower on a strict timer.
Patsy appears unhurried, says the bank was dull, and flatters Sparrow.
The clock chimes midnight unexpectedly, and a light and boots appear in the vault.
Sparrow claims it's the watchman; Patsy sees through it, draws her revolver, and they run.

s01325.summary: In a sauna, Solveig weighs Kwame, who is four-tenths over the limit.
They bicker over minutes, bananas and fear while sweating off the weight.
He pulls the towel lower and she sets the scale between them as steam rolls.

s01332.summary: Soldiers prepare mess in a ruined opera house while distant guns thud.
Doc shares tinned peaches with the men while the sergeant pretends not to notice.
Beaumont asks about the piano and Wróbel jokes about playing badly in Kraków.
A shell lands near and de Vries steadies the men.
The men line up for soup in the sun, and Pryce asks what comes after.

s02488.summary: Ferrywoman Ixara poles Brum across a river of ash.
Brum offers Ixara's own name as his fare.
Brum says he knows her old-tongue name, and insists he will speak it despite her pleas.

s02001.summary: Three soldiers listen to hours of radio static in a chalk tunnel.
Tower radios orders to vacate the ridge by 0400 and blow the tunnel mouth.
Elspeth orders the set packed and codebooks burned.
Bastian gives Elspeth his letter to post, and they exit into the dark.

s00195.summary: New hire Neha meets gruff mailroom supervisor Gerald and his alive copier.
Don announces absurd quarterly efficiency changes, and Gerald objects.
Gerald blames Don for late bonus checks; Don deflects with tasks.
Neha asks why they pretend this makes sense, and Don's smile holds too long.

s01350.summary: Astrid and Mateusz play a fierce rooftop fives match at eleven all.
A long ferocious rally ends with Astrid winning the set.
Astrid helps the panting Mateusz up as the barge horn sounds.

s02126.summary: Inspector Nell enters the defunct bowling office at night with an evidence bag.
Nell plays her earlier tape and answers it, questioning the missing night man.
She rewinds, writes night man on her palm, and leaves.

s00858.summary: Detective Philippa examines the unforced lock on the heron's case as suspects watch.
Only three keys exist; Ludo proves his, while others fidget nervously.
Philippa shows an ibis feather, proving the specimen was swapped for something valuable.
Ludo quietly says the case was never empty, and everyone turns to him.
